title: Agents Install Script Review
description: Debugger-style execution trace of install.sh → scripts/install.mjs: CLI routing, bundle render, core plan, validation gates, and atomic profile activation.

modes.notes: Render bundle, link targets, activate profile

props.body: Use the Call stack panel to step through install.mjs. Frames are verified against the repo via visual-artifact trace inspect. Dry-run is default; --apply required for writes.

impacts.title: Blocks active profile swap
impacts.description: Prevents partial activation when validation or deps failed.

facts.excerpt: if (process.exitCode) throw new Error("refusing active profile swap because an earlier install or validation step failed");

focus.text: if (process.exitCode) throw new Error("refusing active profile swap because an earlier install or validation step failed");

events.summary: Final step: atomically repoint ~/.local/state/agents/active to candidate bundle.

events.summary: Symlink swap with rollback if replacement fails and active was removed.

boundary.policy: No-op in dry-run; rollback previous on failure

transformation.summary: Atomic rename-based pointer swap makes profile activation all-or-nothing.

props.code:

./install.sh --profile personal

# Apply profile bundle
./install.sh --profile personal --apply

# Full apply with pinned runtime updates
./install.sh --profile personal --apply --install-deps

# Health check
./install.sh --doctor --profile personal
